title: Warp
text: Apply projective or affine transformation, 3 inputs, 2 outputs, {Interpolation method} sets Method for interpolating transformed pixel values; {Transformation matrix for source} sets the source for passing transformation matrix Input, {Transformation matrix} sets the value for transformation matrix 3-by-2, {Background fill value} sets the intensity value for background pixels in the transformed, {Output image position source} sets the source for passing output image size Same as input, {Output image position vector [x y width height]} sets the size of the output image, {Enable ROI input port} sets the input ROI, {Enable output port indicating if any part of ROI is outside input image} sets the output if transformed ROI is outside the specified image and {Simulate using} sets the block simulation method Interpreted. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Err_roi
ports.summary: Indicator for transformed ROI outside image region 0 | 1

params.name: Transformation matrix for source
params.values: Source for passing transformation matrix Input port (default) | Custom

params.name: Transformation matrix
params.values: Value for transformation matrix 3-by-2 matrix | 3-by-3 matrix

params.name: Interpolation method
params.values: Method for interpolating transformed pixel values Bilinear (default) | Nearest neighbor | Bicubic

params.name: Background fill value
params.values: Intensity value for background pixels in the transformed image 0 (default) | scalar | 3-element vector

params.name: Output image position source
params.values: Source for passing output image size Same as input image (default) | Custom

params.name: Output image position vector [x y width height]
params.values: Size of the output image [ 1 1 512 512 ] (default) | 4-element vector

params.name: Enable output port indicating if any part of ROI is outside input image
params.values: Output if transformed ROI is outside the specified image size off (default) | on

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Block simulation method Interpreted Execution (default) | Code Generation
